credentials: the neo SSH password is held in-session only and appears in NO file in this repository, committed or not. harness/sync.sh reads it from an exported SSHPASS and never from a literal or a command line.
gate: authored blob hashes below, NOT live HEAD (SUBAGENT_BRIEF). The orchestrator commits sibling experiments continuously, so a cross-run gate written as 'HEAD must not move' would abort mid-sequence through no fault of this experiment (that happened to EXP-0082).

matrix.note: the GENERATOR is frozen here; the case LIST depends on the anchor report extracted on the target and its sha256 is recorded in PROGRESS.md before the first gated run

no_commit: this agent does NOT git commit; the orchestrator reviews and commits

observation.invalid_rule: a read-back that is entirely poison, or whose PRE/POST/tail sentinel failed, or that carries an InnocentVictim-class OS string, is validity!=valid and is RE-RUN -- NEVER recorded as silent_zero. EXP-0160 saw 25 dispatches report STATUS OK and write nothing at all with no victim string.
observation.poison: 0xDEADBEEF on every word before every dispatch
observation.sentinels: PRE is written to MEMORY BEFORE the block (so no later register write can destroy it) and POST is materialized AFTER the block. Neither can be zeroed by release-on-read, which is how EXP-0138 lost six sweeps to a sentinel in r11. The tail region is outside the register file entirely.

pinned_toolchain.why: tools/agx-isa/db.json DRIFTS while sibling experiments extend the ISA (EXP-0165 owns it right now). EXP-0144's frozen matrix hash stopped reproducing for exactly this reason: its case labels were read from a db.json whose field NAMES later moved (pack_convert byte 7 was `fmt_word`, is now `b7`), so its committed raw can no longer be joined by label. This experiment pins a snapshot AND records the full instruction bytes on every case.

prefreeze: raw/prefreeze/** -- anchor extraction and smoke/calibration, NEVER evidence

also_required: liveness ladder passed in EVERY gated run (>=2 distinct observed digests)
falsifier FAILED in every gated run
no case counted whose validity != valid
promotion_rule.proven_dont_care: a genuinely inert field can never satisfy the movement clause. It is recorded as `proven-dont-care` when dense coverage + >=2 carriers differing in the field's dimension, EACH PASSING ITS LADDER + 0 movement + >=99.5%% agreement + falsifier fired, and is reported to the orchestrator with the ladder numbers rather than labelled hardware-run unilaterally.
promotion_rule.skip_placeholders: cases not dispatched because a hang budget was exhausted are marked as placeholders and excluded from every count. EXP-0164 scored 248 of EXP-0144's pack_convert.b7 placeholders as measurements.

quiet_window.why: FIELD-SWEEP-PROTOCOL section 7 amended 2026-08-30: if you ask for a quiet window you must RECORD concurrent GPU activity for the duration, so 'the machine was quiet' is a measurement rather than a claim

declared_hazards: if_push.scope sweeps control flow and may hang
atomic_mem sweeps device atomics and may hang

iter_at.grp is a known minefield: EXP-0155 hung at grp = 0x00, 0x01, 0x0f, 0x12, 0x16, 0x18 and EXP-0163 at 0x00 and 0x50, and BOTH tripped the two-hang stop rule, so no run has ever swept past ~25 of 256 values
safety.macvdmtool: FORBIDDEN to this agent without exception. If the neo stops answering: STOP and report BLOCKED.
